name: Puppy (dog)
typical_age_range: Birth to ~12-18 months (size-dependent; giants mature later)
care_checklist: Complete core vaccine series on the clinic schedule
Start parasite prevention as prescribed
Weigh every 1-2 weeks and keep a growth log
Socialization and bite inhibition training
House-training and crate/rest routines
Dental chewing plan and toy safety
Microchip and ID tags
Spay/neuter timing discussion with the veterinarian
source_notes: Age cutoffs vary by breed size. Checklist is preventive-care oriented, not a substitute for a wellness plan.

name: Kitten (cat)
care_checklist: Complete FVRCP kitten series and rabies as required
FeLV testing and FeLV vaccine discussion based on lifestyle
Parasite prevention as prescribed
Litter box setup and enrichment
Nutrition appropriate for growth (measured meals)
Play and socialization without rough hand play
Microchip and indoor safety proofing
Spay/neuter timing discussion with the veterinarian
source_notes: FeLV recommendations are lifestyle-dependent per AAFP guidance themes.

name: Adult (dog)
typical_age_range: ~1-7 years (earlier senior transition for giant breeds)
care_checklist: Annual (or as advised) wellness exam
Keep core vaccines current; add lifestyle vaccines if indicated
Year-round parasite prevention as prescribed
Body condition scoring and weight checks
Dental home care and professional cleaning as advised
Exercise plan matched to breed energy
Update emergency contacts and records vault
Discuss breed-risk screening with the veterinarian

name: Adult (cat)
care_checklist: Annual wellness exam (more often if outdoor or chronic disease)
Keep core vaccines current based on lifestyle
Parasite prevention as prescribed
Weight and muscle-condition monitoring
Litter box hygiene and urinary habit notes
Dental care plan
Environmental enrichment and scratching outlets
Keep vaccine certificates and medical PDFs in one vault

name: Senior (dog)
care_checklist: Exam every 6 months unless otherwise directed
Baseline and trend labs as recommended
Pain and mobility screening (joints, spine)
Dental disease management
Cognitive change notes (sleep, disorientation, housetraining)
Calorie adjustment to avoid sarcopenia vs obesity
Medication log with dose times
Quality-of-life tracking with the care team
source_notes: Senior age cutoffs are not universal. NEEDS_VET_REVIEW before publishing breed-specific senior age claims.

name: Senior (cat)
care_checklist: Exam every 6 months unless otherwise directed
Kidney, thyroid, and blood pressure screening as advised
Track appetite, water intake, and litter box output
Dental disease management
Weight and muscle loss monitoring
Pain assessment (mobility, grooming decline)
Medication and diet transition logs
Home modifications for arthritis (steps, litter box access)
source_notes: CKD and hyperthyroidism are common senior feline themes in clinical practice; screening cadence is veterinarian-directed.
